cited_by.title: CCCA: scarring hair loss at the crown

record.finding: CCCA mostly presents as progressive thinning of the central scalp, may resemble androgenetic alopecia or alopecia areata, and is underrecognised and often misdiagnosed. Dermoscopy and biopsy remain important.
